evidence.calibration_method: pairs confirmed by a case-insensitive quote prefix of 6+ words vs random pairs, midpoint of q25(positive) and q75(negative)

calibration.primary_rule_declaration: Declared on 2026-09-22, before any calibration result on real embeddings was computed. The threshold decides whether the top-1 sentence the encoder picks among the speaker's sentences becomes semantic_match_high, so the primary rule calibrates that decision directly: on train opinions whose quoted spans were removed (masked_quotes benchmark), top-1 is correct when it agrees with the quote target, and the threshold maximizes Youden's J of 'score >= t predicts a correct top-1'. The three pair rules are reported for comparison with the historical 0.47 and are not used to choose the threshold. Writing the chosen value into [evidence].embedding_threshold is a separate, recorded step.
calibration.bootstrap_unit_reason: opinions of the same hearing share speakers, topic and transcript, so they are not independent; each bootstrap replicate resamples whole hearings and redraws the random negatives
